@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The new bridge has brought considerable b______ts to the residents. For example, it will reduce the time required to travel from one side of the city to the other.
= benefits
~詞義 benefit（n.）好處
~原文 The new bridge has brought considerable benefits to the residents. For example, it will reduce the time required to travel from one side of the city to the other.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: E______e weather, such as very warm winters and hot summers, has become increasingly common in recent years.
= extreme
~詞義 extreme（adj.）極端的
~原文 Extreme weather, such as very warm winters and hot summers, has become increasingly common in recent years.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: By the 1980s, oil had r______ed agricultural products as the country's main export. Decades later, the nation became a net importer of basic food items.
= replaced
~詞義 replace（v.）取代
~原文 By the 1980s, oil had replaced agricultural products as the country's main export. Decades later, the nation became a net importer of basic food items.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Doctors are sometimes ______ (threat) with violence if they don't do what their patients want.
= threatened
~詞義 threaten（v.）威脅
~原文 Doctors are sometimes threatened with violence if they don't do what their patients want.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The international ______ (organize) was founded to promote peace and protect human rights.
= organization
~詞義 organization（n.）組織
~原文 The international organization was founded to promote peace and protect human rights.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It never ceases to ______ me how John can talk for so long without ever saying anything interesting.
A: amaze
B: organize
C: engage
D: locate
= A
~詞義 amaze（v.）使驚訝
~原文 It never ceases to amaze me how John can talk for so long without ever saying anything interesting.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ noise of the machine is driving me crazy.
A: amazing
B: distant
C: constant
D: native
= C
~詞義 constant（adj.）持續的
~原文 The constant noise of the machine is driving me crazy.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After being ______ for two days, Mr. Smith finally woke up, which brought great relief to his family.
A: organic
B: unconscious
C: scientific
D: religious
= B
~詞義 unconscious（adj.）失去意識的
~原文 After being unconscious for two days, Mr. Smith finally woke up, which brought great relief to his family.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When the teacher asked Bill to answer a question, he ______ silent as if he hadn't heard anything.
A: remained
B: withdrew
C: suffered
D: processed
= A
~詞義 remain（v.）保持
~原文 When the teacher asked Bill to answer a question, he remained silent as if he hadn't heard anything.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The doctor performed a ______ check-up to ensure the patient's recovery was going smoothly.
A: talented
B: present
C: risky
D: routine
= D
~詞義 routine（adj.）例行性的
~原文 The doctor performed a routine check-up to ensure the patient's recovery was going smoothly.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: medal
B: native
C: local
D: organic
E: religion
F: engaged

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Despite her illness, Alice remains actively ______ in promoting gender equality.
= F
~詞義 engaged（adj.）參與
~原文 Despite her illness, Alice remains actively engaged in promoting gender equality.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The swimmer was a gold ______ winner at the Olympic Games.
= A
~詞義 medal（n.）獎牌
~原文 The swimmer was a gold medal winner at the Olympic Games.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. Chen speaks English without a foreign accent. He sounds like a(n) ______ speaker.
= B
~詞義 native（adj.）本國的
~原文 Mr. Chen speaks English without a foreign accent. He sounds like a(n) native speaker.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The car industry in this country is dominated by five international companies; ______ ones find it hard to compete with them.
= C
~詞義 local（adj.）當地的
~原文 The car industry in this country is dominated by five international companies; local ones find it hard to compete with them.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The constitution promises freedom of ______ for all citizens; people are allowed to hold any beliefs.
= E
~詞義 religion（n.）宗教
~原文 The constitution promises freedom of religion for all citizens; people are allowed to hold any beliefs.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: deposit
B: beware
C: conscious
D: suffer
E: threat
F: unique

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The train station is closed because of a bomb ______. The police are trying to find the criminal.
= E
~詞義 threat（n.）威脅
~原文 The train station is closed because of a bomb threat. The police are trying to find the criminal.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The operation was successful, but the patient was not fully ______ yet.
= C
~詞義 conscious（adj.）有意識的
~原文 The operation was successful, but the patient was not fully conscious yet.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is very common for people to pay a two-month ______ before they move into a rented apartment.
= A
~詞義 deposit（n.）押金
~原文 It is very common for people to pay a two-month deposit before they move into a rented apartment.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Don't hesitate to get professional help if you ______ from depression.
= D
~詞義 suffer（v.）遭受(苦難、折磨)
~原文 Don't hesitate to get professional help if you suffer from depression.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jennifer has a ______ ability to imitate any sound she hears.
= F
~詞義 unique（adj.）獨特的
~原文 Jennifer has a unique ability to imitate any sound she hears.
